_comment: free-tier-v2 wave, FEED/DASHBOARD scout. 5 new keys. feedStatus.mode{Processing,Error,Limited} give FeedStatusIndicator a state-dependent accessibility label (the capped state was signalled by amber ink alone; feedStatus.idle already exists and is reused for idle/deferred, not re-added). feed.dailyLimit.free{Title,BodyWithTime} are the FREE-TIER variant of the daily cap notice: for a free user the cap is the product, not a failure, so it must not reuse the amber failure copy a Professional user sees. No collisions, no --allow-overwrite needed. The existing feed.dailyLimit.body (the untimed 'unlock tomorrow' string) is deliberately NOT retranslated: it is false west of UTC and is now unreachable, since a reset instant always exists.
